rationale: Switch the two-block recurrent tail from a delayed second sweep to per-block interleaved refinement. This is a new recurrence-order experiment on top of the current recurrent-tail baseline: it adds no model parameters, preserves compile-stable shapes, keeps the exact quant-aware/export path intact, and lets block 8 see a twice-refined block-7 state instead of waiting until after the whole tail sweep.
title: Interleaved Tail Recurrence Refinement
